steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Sob... My poor Sacred Sword...

This is the seventh time that Mess is forging the Sacred Sword for you. Her programming seems to have gotten used to your cycle of ill-intentioned actions. Even her complaints and sobs are coming out calmly.
The Ambrosia in the bottle is also dwindling, and will soon bottom out. You sit patiently next to her and watch her repeat the monotonous labor.
Only when she is forging can she escape from the preprogrammed lines and chat with you a bit.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You really like forging swords, huh?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yeah. Humans are small and weak, but my weapons can make them strong and powerful.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: I feel very accomplished when I arm someone small and weak to defeat the Great Dreadlord.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Why don't you go yourself, then?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Because I'm not the Hero. You are. Only the Hero can defeat Draco with the Sacred Sword.
You recall the complaints of the power-deprived Dreadlord.

steps.speaker: Draco
steps.content: But someone feared me for being powerful. She feared ☐☐, so this world stole my power! Without my ☐☐, all the ☐☐ in this world has been taken away!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Do you fear Draco? Are you afraid to face him?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Of course not! Sigh... I'm definitely not afraid of him. I just... want to fight him in my own way. Yeah!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yes, I'm quite clear that I have to defeat him. Forging the Sacred Sword is my way of fighting.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: You're the Hero. I forge the Sacred Sword for you. When you defeat Draco with the sword I forged, the victory is also mine.
Though Mess deserves a good beating in real life, she cannot lie in her subconscious world. At this moment, the young spirit-forger seems sincere and determined—adorable, even.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I've met someone who's a lot like you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She can extract ma... dark substance from people's hearts, and then turn it into spiritual energy to strengthen her weapons.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She says that only a blade sharpened by darkness can cut through darkness. To defeat her Dreadlord, she even picked up the enemy's sword. Defeating the Dreadlord with the Dreadlord's power is crazy, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But it looks like she's full of passion.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Are you implicitly criticizing me? Hmph! I'm full of passion when I'm working, too!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Enough. I'm crafting this sword for you, Hero. Come help!

You didn't expect such an invitation from her. You freeze for a moment, then take the bottle of Ambrosia from her hands with a smile. Like a blacksmith's apprentice, you help her pour it over the clay doll...
Then, with a shudder of your hands, you spill the remaining Ambrosia all over the floor.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hey! I told you to pour it slowly! I didn't ask you to pour everything, you dumb Hero!
Smiling gleefully, you hold the empty bottle upside down.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do we do? The Ambrosia is all used up, but the sword hasn't been forged. Will someone come to replenish the supply?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Yeah, but...
The sky swiftly becomes dark. With a creak, the door to the back room opens. A woman drawn in the same jagged style walks out, but you still recognize her instantly.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: Good evening, little Mess.
She turns around and walks towards you, but ignores you completely. She just gently stabilizes the glass bottle in your hand, as if you're just a table for putting things on.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: ...Come out, "Marv"...
As she calls out the name "Marv," the woman summons an empty crystal bottle. She tips it gently toward the container in your hand, as if pouring something invisible.
She then squeezes hard, and a powerful force stimulates the bottle in her hand. You hear a strange, bloodcurdling scream coming from inside the bottle.
At the same time, Ambrosia gradually condenses in the empty bottle. Shining radiantly, it slowly flows out and fills the glass container in your hand.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: There you go. Thanks to you, many more will be blessed with sweet dreams, happiness and smiles tonight. We all want to thank you, little Mess.

steps.speaker: Gaudy Woman
steps.content: I also look forward to the day you try Ambrosia yourself. Hope you can escape the dark night and embrace a sweet dream.
She bows to you gently like a curtain call. Blue smoke rises, and the woman disappears. The sky clears up again.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: ...Hey!

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Hehe, your eyes are about to pop out. Is she your type?

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Too bad she's not real. She repeats the same set of lines every time she comes, like a puppet. She's just data, like all the other preprogrammed NPCs.
... She still remembers the concept of game programming.

You know very well that the woman is a hallucination constructed by Mess's subconscious. She's also Mess's supplier, the maker of Ambrosia, and someone who is involved with the "Marv" case. It doesn't seem that Mess likes her.
This dream has given you more than enough intelligence. You must return to reality and take action.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: The sword is ready. Here, take it. You have the Sacred Sword now. Time to go fight the Dreadlord Draco.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My Draco isn't here. Nor is this the world I need to say.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I need to go save my own world now.
Mess's eyes widen.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What nonsense are you talking about?! If you leave, who's gonna defeat Draco?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No one. He's not your vicious dragon either.

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come with me, Mess. I'll show you the truth about this world. Let's leave together.
